action_summary: Round 4's receipt named its own bottleneck: a 42-command debugger cost 26 questions and every one was about a COMMAND. This round asked about the way of asking instead. Four channels were priced on this machine (batch `-c help` 2.3-36 ms, the page 2.1-56 ms, the live prompt 4-1420 ms, and `strings` at 0.2 ms which was later deleted), the hypothesis space was cut to the two axes that exist -- SHAPE (KEY/TOKEN/SUBCOMMAND/OPTION_LANGUAGE/NONE) and COUNTER (COMMANDS/BUILTINS/PATH/OPTIONS), five admissible cells with five uniform priors and no learned weights -- and the policy is one line: ask the cheapest channel that can still split the survivors, stop when one cell survives. The claim was made falsifiable by an operational oracle: the same program asked the same question at its own prompt must publish the same KIND of evidence. It holds in 2 rooms of 7 and fails in 5, and the receipt prints every disagreement with its numbers. Most of the round's value is in having built the oracle and in what it convicted: the text parser I spent the round tuning. Four parser facts each needed a patch and each patch broke a different room (prose split on whitespace became commands; an options page was read as a command table; a wide description field swallowed a command column; a capitalised word rule ate the shell's usage tails). The expected-failure test `test_an_options_page_yields_options_and_no_commands` is kept red on purpose as the evidence that typography cannot be the mechanism.
honest_limits: No benchmark score: OSWorld 2.1, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and SWE-bench Pro V2 cannot execute here (no browser, no X, no container runtime). They remain non-claims.
The generalisation claim is unverified: PAGER -> (OPTION_LANGUAGE, COMMANDS) was learned from `more` and is wrong for `less`.
python3 was placed in the PYTHON_DEBUGGER family by hand and is not that family.
The typography parser fails on 5 rooms of 7 and one test is an expected failure.
One machine, one geometry, one implementation, producer-run only.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: Four routes were measured and rejected in this round rather than argued. (1) A `strings` channel over the binary's own words: cheapest of all at 0.2-260 ms, and it decided no cell in any room; a pager's 31,336 words of strings parsed into ~13,000 'tokens' of prose and symbols; deleted. (2) The `help X` channel: descriptions arrive free in the answer that lists the token, and where they do not, the alphabet is still the whole answer; deleted, saving round 4's 26 x 24 ms. (3) Needles recalled from these programs' manuals: two of four were wrong on the first run and two of four shape claims with them; replaced by what the parser found, printed in the receipt. (4) Tuning admissibility rules until each program landed in the expected cell: four attempts, each breaking a different room (the shell read as a pager, the REPL as a pager, the interpreter as a debugger); abandoned for an operational oracle that costs 600 ms and cannot be argued with.
agent_orientation.independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox only: 15 pins (14 pass, 1 expected failure) and one end-to-end receipt over seven rooms in 5.6 s. The headline claim fails in 5 of 7 rooms and is reported as failing. No independent identity has re-run any of it.

obs_layers_evaluated.1_the_real_goal: A general problem-solving system whose producer path is its own; no benchmark score is claimed because none is runnable here.
obs_layers_evaluated.2_the_current_blocker: Decoding a program's published guide into an alphabet by parsing its typography. The parser is where the round died: five of seven rooms disagree with the operational oracle.
obs_layers_evaluated.3_the_challenger_frontier: Challengers built and killed this round: a `strings` channel, the `help X` channel, recalled needles, a second `if`-chain claim procedure, and four generations of typography rules.
obs_layers_evaluated.4_volatile_dependency_preflight: Zero network, zero model calls, zero incremental spend at run time; the only dependencies are the seven binaries on this machine.
obs_layers_evaluated.5_the_route_race: Deletion won twice and the operational oracle beat the parser: an answer that costs 600 ms and is a FACT beats an answer that costs 0 ms and is a JUDGEMENT.
obs_layers_evaluated.6_the_receipt: This file, plus canonical/verification/THE_GUIDE_IS_A_KEY_TABLE_20261124_V1.json produced end to end in 5.6 s.
obs_layers_evaluated.7_the_decision: KEEP the two-axis hypothesis space and the priced channel order; REJECT the typography parser as the mechanism; DECLARE the next blocker: the family row needs one more axis -- which ways of asking exist at all -- and it must be declared and checked, not parsed.
